input: Reach out to a former colleague for a coffee chat

gold.taskTitle: Reach Out to Former Colleague for Coffee Chat
gold.taskDescription: Contact a specific former colleague to arrange an informal coffee chat meeting.

questions.title: Who is the specific colleague you want to contact?
questions.description: Identify the former colleague by name, role, or company they were associated with.

questions.title: What is your main purpose for this coffee chat?
questions.description: Clarify the primary goal, such as networking, career advice, reconnecting socially, or exploring a collaboration.

questions.title: How long has it been since you last spoke?
questions.description: Understand the recency of the relationship to tailor the tone of the outreach message appropriately.

questions.title: What channel will you use to reach out to them?
questions.description: Determine the preferred contact method, such as email, LinkedIn, phone, or text message.

questions.title: Do you already have their current contact details?
questions.description: Establish whether finding up-to-date contact information is a prerequisite step before reaching out.

questions.title: Is this coffee chat meant to be virtual or in-person?
questions.description: Clarify the intended meeting format, which affects scheduling, location, and logistics.

questions.title: What is your target date to send the outreach message?
questions.description: Pin down a specific deadline or timeframe so the task has a concrete completion target.
